full_text_tesim: 151 Psalms and 10 Odes, preceded by short calendar and followed by prayers in Arabic and Greek. Ending with magic prescription for persons bitten by serpents
Front board single piece of leather with corner missing and remains of flap; part of inside lining is all that is left of back cover.
Greek text on last two leaves

Minor geometric headpieces on ff. 32v, 33v, 101r | Tailpiece on ff. 104v, 105v, triangle motif | Vegetative decoration on f. 132v, fleur de lis | Illustration of a man's face, f. 132v | Illustration, man with nimbus, f. 133r
The sequence of ff. 31, 32, 33 is repeated once and then f. 34 follows
